result.target_topic: Completion of Organizational Simplification and New Structure
result.target_summary: In the first quarter of 2024, Citi completed its organizational simplification announced in September 2023, establishing a simpler management structure to align with strategy and improve accountability. The changes eliminated three legacy operating segments and consolidated regions from four to two, resulting in five new reportable operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking) and a new financial reporting structure.

comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan executed significant organizational simplifications in 2024 to realign their operating segments with strategic goals. Citi completed its simplification in the first quarter of 2024, eliminating three legacy segments and consolidating regions to establish five new reportable operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking). JPMorgan reorganized its reportable segments effective in the second quarter of 2024, combining the Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking into a single Commercial & Investment Bank segment, resulting in three reportable segments. Both disclosures highlight the reduction of complexity and the establishment of new, streamlined reporting structures to improve management focus.

sentences.text: During the first quarter of 2024, Citi completed its organizational simplification announced in September 2023.

Citi's operating model changes included elimination of the Institutional Clients Group, Personal Banking and Wealth Management and Legacy Franchises operating segments and resulted in the five current reportable operating segments-Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth and U.S. Personal Banking-and a new financial reporting structure.

Business segments & Corporate: Effective in the second quarter of 2024, the Firm reorganized its reportable business segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking business segments to form one reportable segment, the Commercial & Investment Bank.

As a result of the reorganization, the Firm has three reportable business segments - Consumer & Community Banking ("CCB"), Commercial & Investment Bank ("CIB") and Asset & Wealth Management ("AWM") - with the remaining activities in Corporate.

comparisons.peer_summary: Effective in Q2 2024, JPMorgan reorganized its reportable segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking into the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB), resulting in three total reportable segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management.
comparisons.comparison: JPMorgan's 2024 reorganization mirrors Citi's organizational simplification in terms of creating new, consolidated reportable segments to streamline operations. JPMorgan combined its Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking into one Commercial & Investment Bank segment in Q2 2024. Similarly, Citi eliminated legacy operating segments and consolidated regions in Q1 2024 to create five new reportable segments. Both companies utilized this restructuring to align with updated management structures and strategic priorities, though the specific segment names and timing differed.
